result: Viewing RMSProp/Adam as SGD preconditioned by E[ggᵀ]^{−1/2}, the preconditioner makes gradient noise isotropic near stationary points, so weak-noise escape directions get pushed; with an online estimate this gives the first second-order guarantee for an adaptive method, Õ(τ^{−5}) to a (τ, √(ρτ))-stationary point.
result_plain: Adaptive methods whiten gradient noise near saddles and escape faster; first second-order result for RMSProp.
